parts.script:
Sarah: Hey Mark, have you thought about our weekend trip? I really think we should go to the mountains. The weather is perfect for hiking.  
Mark: That sounds great, but do you think we should book a cabin or just camp outside?  
Sarah: I prefer a cabin to be honest. It will be more comfortable, especially if it gets chilly at night.  
Mark: Good point. Plus, we can cook meals there. I love a good campfire dinner!  
Sarah: Absolutely! Also, we should make a list of things to bring, like food and hiking gear.  
Mark: Right, and don’t forget about the first aid kit. We wouldn’t want any accidents on the trails.  
Sarah: True! What else do you think we’ll need?  
Mark: A camera for sure. So many beautiful views! And maybe a guidebook about the local trails?  
Sarah: Good idea! I’ll check online for some options, then we can finalize our plans.  
Mark: Sounds like a plan! This is going to be so much fun!  
Sarah: I can’t wait!
